freeze_discipline.why: Deductive lane. The theorem is proved for all finite n; the enumeration over n <= 5 is a regression check of the proof, not its basis. No outcome is accessed and nothing is sampled.
freeze_discipline.substituted_guard: Soundness is decided by explicit simulation over every adversary break-set, never by the shortcut 'R is sound iff R contains A(Delta)' -- that shortcut is the statement under test. Three negative controls must fire, and the generalization must reproduce the paper's published counts without reading them.
post_outcome_changes_forbidden: weakening the necessity direction after a counterexample
narrowing the DAG enumeration to hide an instance
assuming the soundness shortcut to make the check pass

claims_under_test: A(Delta) is sound for every finite DAG and every Delta.
Every proper subset of A(Delta) is unsound.
A(Delta) is therefore the unique minimal sound revalidation set.
The registered five-coordinate model is a special case, reproducing 155 and 1055.
assumptions_stated_explicitly: donor-native certificates remain valid when native premises do not change
obligations outside A(Delta) are stable under the update
for each j in A(Delta) there is an admissible instance whose break-set is exactly {j} (the declared separation witness)
explicitly_not_claimed: that the registered five lift coordinates are the right coordinates
that the registered dependency graph is correct
universal minimality of the five lift coordinates
novelty over donor-owned reachability / incremental-verification machinery
discharge of external_independent_validation, which remains CANNOT_CHECK

independent_checker_requirements.independence_rule: No committed ORION-16 module may be imported. Closure, adversary model and soundness must be implemented from their definitions, and published counts reconstructed rather than read.
independent_checker_requirements.exhaustiveness: all DAGs on n <= 5 under a fixed topological order, all Delta subsets
independent_checker_requirements.vacuity_rule: soundness must be simulated over adversary break-sets; assuming the containment shortcut is forbidden
independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: exit code 3, status CANNOT_CHECK, never reported as a pass

would_license: restating V4.4 as a structural theorem about arbitrary finite dependency graphs rather than one registered model
citing dependency reachability, not adjacency, as the operative relation
would_not_license: any statement about which coordinates belong in the graph
universal minimality of the five lift coordinates

stop_rule: Complete. Generates no experiment and raises no blocker.
